en: Calendar: 30 days in a season, four seasons in a year.
City treasury. Buildings are paid in Silver.
Q / E rotate, mouse wheel zoom, WASD or middle mouse to move.
No road access: it will not work until a road touches it.
Road (G). Click and drag to lay a road. Walkers and carriers move only on roads.
Demolish (X). Click or drag over an area. Silver is not returned.
R rotate · Esc or right click cancel
Stands on a road. Turns back roaming walkers (vendors, shrine keepers). Carriers, buyers and settlers pass.
No road access: carriers cannot come or go.
A carrier is on the way to storage. Next load: %d%%
No Granary with free space can be reached by road. Production stops when the store is full.
No Storehouse with free space can be reached by road. Production stops when the store is full.
Full: %d of %d loads. Build another storage.
Straw roof, mud walls, and a jar of rice by the door.
Two rooms, one fire, and a little shrine for luck.
The first tiles on the street. The neighbors noticed.
Missing, the house will drop a level in %d days:
This is the highest level for now.
People living in the city. Settlers come through the valley entrance when houses have room.
Workers available / workers the buildings need. 40% of residents work.
Connect a road to the valley entrance so settlers can come.
Market vendor last passed %d days ago.
No Market vendor walks past this house.
Shrine keeper last passed %d days ago.
No shrine keeper walks past this house.
The shrine keeper sets out soon.
Could not save the game. The previous save is kept.
There is no saved game yet. Press Ctrl+S to save.
The save file is damaged and cannot be loaded.
This save comes from a newer version of the game.
This save comes from an older version of the game and cannot be loaded.
No workers: every pair of hands in the city already has a job. More houses, more workers.
Working at %d%% speed: not enough workers. Next load: %d%%
The fetcher is bringing %s from a Storehouse.
Out of %s. The fetcher sets out for a Storehouse soon.
No %s: none is on the way, and no Storehouse in reach by road holds any.
%s goes only to a Fermentation Yard, and there is none yet. Production stops when the store is full.
Goods (F4): what the city has, what it makes, and where it is short.
The Fermentation Yard has no room for more %s. Production stops when the store is full.
No jars yet: Clay Jars from a Pottery Kiln (or a Storehouse) become the jars of this yard.
Every jar holds Soybean Paste (Fresh %d, Ripe %d). A jar is filled again once its paste goes to the Market.
Ripe Soybean Paste goes twice as far, but takes two more seasons in the jar. Click to switch.
Carrier: taking %s to where it is needed.
Vendor: on the streets, tile %d of %d.
Shrine keeper: on the streets, tile %d of %d.
Nobody from here is out right now.
The city has %d workers for %d jobs. Newer buildings get workers last.
Shows on the map what this building reaches. Houses in range: green when they have its service, red when not.
No %s to sell: the Buyer finds no %s in reach by road.
No Soybean Paste in the house.
No Clay Jars in the house.
